Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred from the IMDb page that the “Narrator (voice)” (Jeremy Davidson) plays the title character, Jason Bourne, in “Robert Ludlum’s The Bourne Betrayal.” The page did not list a Jason Bourne actor, and “The Bourne Betrayal” is primarily a novel with no widely released film by that exact title. The correct conclusion should have been that no film exists with a credited Bourne actor for that title and, in the main film series, Jason Bourne is played by Matt Damon.
